“Well, Hyung’s  tastes are a bit old-fashioned.”
……That was also possible only when the opponent was an idiot.
Please! I won’t like a guy like you!

81619.synopsis:
Foolish children are the cutest, aren’t they?
My name is Ren Saionji. I am the eldest son of the Saionji family, one of the four great noble families.
One day, when my father introduced me to my stepmother and my half-sister, Kikka, I suddenly remembered that this was the world of the hit light novel from my previous life, “The Bride of Shirayuri.”
If things continue as they are, our family will fall into ruin because of my villainous sister, Kikka Saionji. To prevent this, I decided to give her proper and healthy education to grow her into a pure, righteous, and beautiful young lady!
This is the story of me, who thought, “Isn’t this just a mob reincarnation?!” I, an ordinary guy in my previous life, even ended up summoning the strongest guardian beast, the White Tiger. With the power of Inou, I became the strongest of my time. While shouldering the expectations of those around me, I dedicated myself to educating my sister to avoid ruin. As a result, I ended up creating a noble young lady who is overly obsessed with her big brother to a slightly concerning degree.
associated_names: 悪役令嬢の兄に転生した華族令息の俺、破滅回避のために妹教育を頑張ったら、最高に可愛いブラコン令嬢を爆誕させてしまいました
悪役華族令嬢の兄に転生した俺、破滅回避のために妹教育を頑張ったら、最高に可愛いブラコン令嬢が爆誕しました

81875.synopsis:
When Lu Ning was young, he was sponsored by the legendary wealthy Zhou Jiayu, and since then, he has regarded the gentle and elegant Zhou Jiayu as his idol and goal in life. He once lamented that if only they had been born in the same era, they might have become friends.
Unexpectedly, after a night’s sleep, he transmigrated into the body of a teenager in the early 1990s. At that moment, he was sitting by the window on the second floor of a tube-shaped apartment doing homework, while downstairs, a group of delinquent boys were fighting. The leader was wearing a denim jacket, sporting a haircut like Aaron Kwok, spewing colorful language, and was the most aggressive.
Moments later, the victorious leader came upstairs. As he passed Lu Ning’s house, he leaned against the window with a cigarette in his mouth and smirked roguishly. “Hey kid, what are you looking at? Do you think your brother here is handsome?”
This person was none other than a nearly thirty years younger, Zhou Jiayu.
Lu Ning felt like crying in the wind… ‘Where is my gentle and elegant idol?’
Eventually, Zhou Jiayu indeed became Lu Ning’s friend—well, his boyfriend.
The 1990s were a time of both opportunities and risks. This era, which once belonged to Zhou Jiayu, also belongs to Lu Ning now.

82131.synopsis:
At twenty-seven, Ara received an unusual birthday present: her father’s 1 billion won gambling debt. Desperate and pursued by loan sharks, she fled to her childhood village, where she had lived with her grandmother.
With nowhere else to go, she took refuge in an abandoned house halfway up a rugged mountain known as the goblin house, a place shunned by everyone.
“…Could you be my husband?”
There, Ara encountered a man of otherworldly beauty.
“Hey. Who said I’m your husband? Are you trying to ruin my marriage prospects?”
This goblin king was unlike any other—using a smartphone instead of a club and sunglasses instead of a cap.
“Do you want to make a bet with me?”
To repay her debt, Ara agreed to a three-month temporary cohabitation with him.
“If you want to touch someone else’s body, you need to get permission first.”
“If I say I want to touch, will you give me permission then?”
Navigating the tests set by the demanding goblin king proved to be a challenging journey…
Is this a miraculous fate or a trick of the gods?

82899.synopsis:
To be able to meet each other on this planet is some kind of fate, and to be able to illuminate our fleeting lives, how fortunate we are.
Shi Ci thought that her first meeting with Tang Zhou was at the cafeteria on the first floor of Nancheng University. At that time, her younger brother pointed at Tang Zhou and said to her, “Sis! That’s the girl I want to pursue!”
Tang Zhou thought that her first meeting with Shi Ci was on the campus road of Nancheng University. That evening, she was returning late from her part-time job and was hit by Shi Ci’s car.
However, that was not the truth.

84947.synopsis:
I was called a hero. The hero who saved the world. However, I was used by those who whispered words of friendship to me. In the end, I was betrayed and killed. But then…
“I didn’t expect to be resurrected in this manner.”
I had returned, not in my original body, but in the body of the eldest son of a duke I had never heard of, Aden Remes.
associated_names: Duke's Eldest Son Is A Regressed Hero

85459.synopsis:
An anti: I heard that you are being kept by Gu Xiao?
Su Xi: What? What child? Oh yes… How do you know that I have his child? It’s so embarrassing~~~
Su Xi advised fans online: Tsk tsk tsk, sisters, love is not advisable. Love should be illegal. Ah, the love just shouldn’t exist!
In reality, he stretched out his little claws to hug Gu Xiao: Let me hug my husband, spend all the money I earn on him, I love my husband the most mua~ mua~ mua~
An anti: Shame on you! Climbing into bed for resources! It’s so disgusting. People like you should get out of the entertainment industry quickly. Get out!!!
Su Xi rolled his eyes: Don’t worry, don’t worry. Don’t get angry at me first. Let me think of something to accuse you in return.
Gu Xiao: What’s wrong?
Su Xi turned his head. With red eyes and mouth forming a pout, he threw himself into his Alpha’s arms and cried: Husband, they all bullied me. You have to avenge me~
(He whispered in his heart: You scolded my rotten mouth and broke my leg, thank you.)
Gu Xiao raised his eyebrows, pinched the back of Su Xi’s neck, and coaxed him: Okay, I will catch them all.
associated_names: The little peach raised by the top Alpha is very fierce
顶级Alpha豢养的小蜜桃超凶

85715.synopsis:
“I need a dominant Omega to bear my child, not someone to have a romantic affair with.”
All she had was the trait of a dominant Omega, a pretty face, and a bit of artistic talent—Johanna, the fallen noblewoman.
She needed money to pay off her father’s debt and protect her young brother. She secretly had a crush on this man, but that was a secret she could never let slip.
“Why did you apply?”
“Because I need money.”
“Anything else?”
“…No.”
Hiding the feelings she had harbored for so long, she agreed to stay by his side and sleep with him to bear an heir. But this relationship, which was supposed to be purely transactional, began to take an unexpected turn…
“Don’t worry, Marquis.”
“About what?”
“No matter what others say, I don’t care. And I know what my role is. I’ve never harbored any hopes of being your partner…”
“…..”
His eyes darkened instantly as he quietly shut his mouth, as if ready to grab and devour her whenever she tried to distance herself.

89299.synopsis:
Baroness Aurelia Prevoria of the Loskeller family worked hard to support her impoverished barony. Her specialty, light magic, was essential for lighting up the vast royal castle every night, earning her a generous salary. However, one day while at work, Aurelia accidentally stumbled upon a secret rendezvous between Prince Hugues and Lady Solange, the daughter of Marquis Aflia. This incident caused a stir throughout the castle, and for some reason, Aurelia was unjustly exiled as punishment.
Determined to find work, Aurelia set out on a journey and soon discovered a job posting from the Domorax family. Seizing the opportunity, she went to present herself to Duke Morgan, the head of the household. Impressed by her experience of illuminating the entire royal castle, Morgan warmly welcomed her. As Duke Morgan had a natural sensitivity to sunlight, to the point where he could rarely go outside, he was deeply fond of the artificial light produced by Aurelia’s magic. Grateful for her assistance, Morgan kept Aurelia close by.
Meanwhile, the royal castle, which had cast Aurelia out, was left in darkness.
associated_names: 私のせいで婚約破棄されたそうでお城を解雇されました。

89811.synopsis:
Yu Yuanyuan, in order to save her father, accidentally entered the world of a book and turned into a three-and-a-half-year-old little toddler.
In the story, her father is an evil villain who has more enemies than she’s had meals. His fate is tragic, ending in a gruesome death with no remains left behind.
The little toddler huffed and puffed, determined to change the plot and make her father a good person.
With teary eyes, Yu Yuanyuan cried, “Daddy, please don’t do bad things!”
Yu Jinxiao, who was just about to throw someone into the sea, paused. “…No, Daddy was just thinking about giving Uncle a swimming lesson.”
Yu Yuanyuan, holding a swim ring in one hand and his hand in the other, said, “Then Yuanyuan will swim with Daddy too!”
Yu Jinxiao: “…”
To prevent his little girl from growing up with bad influences, Yu Jinxiao tried his hardest to suppress his violent tendencies and be a good man. But every day, there were idiots eyeing his precious daughter.
“Mr. Yu, today two boys at the kindergarten got into a fight over who gets to marry the little miss.”
“Mr. Yu, the newly crowned Best Actor secretly tried to coax the little miss into calling him Daddy today.”
“Mr. Yu, that world-famous idol wants to take the little miss out for fun.”
Despite all of Yu Jinxiao’s efforts to protect his precious daughter, just as he finally raised her well, he turned around only to realize—oh no, someone had already stolen her heart!
That once feared and ruthless ultimate villain, now gently hugged Yu Yuanyuan, feeding her candy while softly coaxing her, “Yuanyuan, don’t be mad, okay? I swear I didn’t do anything bad. If you want, I’ll even cut my heart open to show you.”

90323.synopsis:
Everyone said Rong Zhen’s partner, Jiang Jili, was beautiful, talented, and virtuous, adored by a prominent figure.
However, only Jiang Jili knew the truth—he was nothing more than a plaything to Rong Zhen, to be used when Rong Zhen was in a good mood. Despite being married for three years, Jiang Jili had never stepped foot into the master bedroom. He wasn’t worthy. Even when they were intimate, it was confined to his room, with Rong Zhen looming over him like an emperor indulging in a fleeting whim.
In Rong’s household, Jiang’s status didn’t even surpass that of the fierce, unruly Tibetan mastiff. Everyone knew Jiang was terrified of the dog, yet no one intervened. Rong Zhen coldly watched on multiple occasions as the vicious dog pounced on Jiang, leaving him trembling with fear, so much so that he was bedridden with a fever for a week.
At a high-society gathering in Huai City, Jiang drank something tainted and collapsed in a hotel room, gasping for breath. Meanwhile, Rong Zhen, perfectly composed in his suit, toyed with his phone, recording the scene.
Rong Zhen had always considered Jiang a joke.
Later, when Rong Zhen’s grandmother demanded a grandchild, Jiang was discarded like tr*sh. Qin Family’s elegant heiress would surely provide the perfect heir for the Rong family.
Jiang laid the divorce papers before Rong Zhen.
Rong Zhen, leisurely but menacingly, warned him: “If you dare leave this house without my permission, you’ll regret it.”
Jiang left cleanly, without looking back.
By the time Rong Zhen realized what had happened, Jiang Jili had disappeared.
After Jiang disappeared, Rong Zhen became a mad dog.
Suspicious and brooding, his very presence felt like walking through a minefield. Everyone knew that the biggest taboo was mentioning Jiang Jili’s name. Rong Zhen missed Jiang Jili so desperately it nearly drove him insane.
Every night, Rong Zhen slept in Jiang Jili’s room, desperately trying to find any trace of him. But there was nothing.
As if to punish him, the only thing he had left of Jiang Jili was that video—
In it, the young man’s eyes were red, his fingers trembling as he clutched Rong Zhen’s pants, nearly choking on his words: “Help me…”
From the phone’s speaker, Rong Zhen heard his own cold voice:
“Jiang Jili, do you even deserve it?”
A child star named Jiang Chong quickly rose to fame, gaining immense popularity. Despite his young age, Jiang Chong carried himself with a maturity beyond his years. Observant individuals couldn’t help but notice a striking resemblance between the boy and that infamous figure in the Rong family.
Brave reporters sometimes asked, “Does Chong Chong take after his father or his mother?”
Jiang Chong: “My father, my father’s surname is Jiang.”
One day, a picture of Jiang Chong’s father was leaked—a delicate, handsome youth with soft features.
Many people were disappointed, but Rong Zhen went mad.
Jiang Jili.
He could recognize him even if he were reduced to ashes.
associated_names: After I ran away with the ball, my ex-husband was buried in the crematorium
带球跑后前夫火葬场了

91603.synopsis:
Vivian, who has been disillusioned by reality, finds himself in the world of pirates. Determined to live a peaceful life, his plans are disrupted when his patrol ship encounters a Whitebeard pirate ship. Faced with this unexpected danger, Vivian’s mind presents him with several options, each with its own unique reward:
    1. Confront the pirates boldly: Shout and order the ship to approach, earning a random Logia-type Devil Fruit.
    2. Challenge Whitebeard: Use a loudspeaker to demand a 1v1 duel, gaining a random combat skill from another dimension.
    3. Flee: Turn the ship around and escape, receiving a random Zanpakutō.
    4. Surrender: Admit defeat and surrender, increasing a random basic attribute.
After a brief internal struggle, Vivian decides to use the loudspeaker and calls out to Whitebeard, addressing him as “Dad, I’m here!”
associated_names: 海贼：我的脑内危险选项

91859.synopsis:
In Glassdale, the mansion of the northern duke was named after its glass-like frozen pond.
Liam, who was left alone after losing his mother at a young age, becomes a gamekeeper. Where he meets a young master with a bruised and pitiful appearance and a name that means ‘white snow’: Erwin Calliwell. Erwin is as pure and noble as his name.
 Liam deeply admires the young master, who seems different from him, but all he gets in return is cold indifference and ignorance.
 “You barbarian,”
 “Let go. Where are you touching, dirty?”
On the other hand, tired of the discipline and sense of responsibility that oppresses him, as well as his father’s ab*se, Erwin seeks a place to lean on; a lowly servant offers him his shoulder. “I am just a lowly person, a piece of furniture in your room, a rock you step on in the street… It does not matter what you show me.”
 Erwin attempts to deviate for the first time by holding Liam’s hand. That deviation evolved into a different feeling, and a dangerous but even deeper secret was formed between the two.
the threat of war, as well as dark clouds, foreshadow a storm gathering over their heads…
…
Can the two of them stay together while fighting against the angry waves of fate?

92115.synopsis:
I ended up in the same class as the girls I once had a “good thing” going with.
A high school rom-com about regrets and unspoken feelings, where love that was left behind finally gets a second chance!
Ryota Yoshiki had three girls he once shared a “good vibe” with.
His childhood friend from elementary school, who he had grown distant from—Reimi Nikaido.
His carefree gyaru female friend—Yui Yuzuha.
And his laid-back study group companion—Yuka Hanazono.
What if he had been brave enough to confess back then?
In the spring of his first year of high school, those old regrets begin to stir—because now, all four of them are in the same class!
The girls, who once had mutual feelings for Ryota, start getting closer to him again—whether it’s in an empty classroom, during after-school dates in the city, or even at his house at night—as they try to figure out his current feelings.
“I’m really glad you’re here, Ryota.”
“I love spending time with you, Yoshiki.”
“I wonder if we can be close again?”
Trust, affection, admiration—the feelings they kept locked away start to heat up once more!
associated_names: Ano koro ii kanji datta joshi-tachi to onaji kurasu ni narimashita
I Ended Up in the Same Class as the Girls I Used to Have a Good Vibe With
あの頃イイ感じだった女子たちと同じクラスになりました

92883.synopsis:
[ Become Maxim von Waldeck’s wife in name only. ] 
That was the simple mission assigned to Daisy, a secret agent of the revolutionary army.
Maxim von Waldeck, a mercenary born out of wedlock, known as the royal family’s hunting dog.
He was being thrown into the line of fire as cannon fodder, and his chances of surviving the war were slim. No woman was willing to step into the role of becoming a widow.
The plan was straightforward: act as his wife in name during the war, then escape before the kingdom was conquered after their defeat.
If she could pull that off, she’d walk away with a hefty sum and retire comfortably.
“I’ll be back soon, wife.”
Yes, it was nice meeting you. Rest in peace.
“We’ll consummate the marriage when I return.”
You dream big, don’t ya? May you pass on peacefully.
She assumed it was just his hopeful dream of a blissful future.
…But then.
[ Maxim von Waldeck Achieves an Unprecedented Great Victory! ] 
Things went completely opposite of what she had expected.
[ National Hero Grand Duke Waldeck! What do you most look forward to upon your return home? ] 
[ Holding my beloved wife, Daisy, in my arms. ] 
No way, that can’t be right.
This has to be a misprint or something, she thought.
But Maxim von Waldeck was a man who took his promises as seriously as his life.
“I’m back, my wife.”
And with those words, he suddenly pulled her into his arms.
Daisy’s eyes darted around in confusion at his unexpected behavior.
“Shall we head to the bedroom now?”
“Pardon?”
He whispered softly in her ear, a lazy smile painted on his lips.
“Forgive me, but I’m in a bit of a hurry.”
He was already heavy and hot, the front of his trousers straining as if they were about to burst.
‘Is this bastard some sort of pe*verted lunatic?’
Could Daisy safely divorce him before her cover was blown?

93395.synopsis:
She Doesn’t Know I’m Her Brother
I—Rokuro Sanjo—accidentally sent a “like” to my own sister on a dating app. Whether it’s fortunate or not, it seems like she hasn’t realized it’s me, so we’re still chatting… But isn’t she kind of skipping school these days?
◆
Sneezes are such dangerous things. I—Yuuha Sanjo—somehow ended up messaging my own brother. Luckily, it seems he hasn’t figured out it’s me yet… But why did he start living alone?

93907.synopsis:
[Rebirth + ab*se of tr*sh + Sweet Love] In her previous life, Su Li was blind and helped her husband to ascend to a high position. When he became successful, she abandoned him.
Her grandfather’s family and her father, the Shangshu, who had lived a clear and upright life, were decapitated and beheaded. She herself died with two bodies and could not close her eyes. God has eyes and she was reborn. In this life, she protects her relatives and steps on s*umbags and b*tches. When the scars faded, her appearance was stunning.
Her medical skills were superb and amazing. … A certain prince who was upright and elegant outside was clinging to the beauty in his arms: “This prince feels uncomfortable all over, and I need Li’er to check it out.”
associated_names: 重生医妃一睁眼，全京城排队抢亲

94675.synopsis:
In the first year of the Stellar Calendar, humanity stepped into the interstellar age. Space colonization, starships, alien clans, and eldritch outer gods… all came one after another.
By Stellar Calendar Year 717, Fang Xing stood against the backdrop of the cosmos, staring at the densely packed alien armies. He declared, “Alien armies? Cultivators? tent**les? Cults? Outer gods? They’re all going to be awed by my unparalleled talent and smashed to bits by my iron fists! Hah!”
Well… this is actually the story of a transmigrator who relies on a Profession Panel to do as he pleases across countless otherworlds.

95955.synopsis:
In the 27th year of Hongguang, the allied forces of seven nations invaded the Da Lan Dynasty. Rifled guns, mortars, and armored vehicles formed an iron tide, yet they were ultimately defeated by the iron cavalry of Da Lan. Muscle, magic arts, firearms, cannons… old and new forces collided repeatedly in this chaotic age.
Li Fei, armed with a Blood Pearl of Ten Thousand, gradually became an existence akin to a boss character:
“Just this much damage? You haven’t even scratched one-thousandth of my health bar.”
“You don’t think this is enough to kill me, do you?”
“Don’t be hasty. The second phase starts now!”

98003.synopsis:
[Enigma x Alpha] 
“After waking up, I found I had a soft, squishy, and fragrant son. Who understands this?”
“On top of that, I have a sultry and scheming husband who spends all day flirting with me!”
associated_names: Broken Defenses! Pampered to the Heavens by My Yandere Ex-husband After Losing My Memory
破防！失忆后，被病娇前夫宠上天
破防！失憶後，被病嬌前夫寵上天

98771.synopsis:
The era of ‘Returnees’ is overflowing with hunters who have returned from various worlds.
“This is the 358th returnee from Korea. Let’s begin the interview. Could you tell us which genre you came from?”
In an era where returnees from all sorts of worlds coexist—masters from martial arts worlds, demon kings from fantasy adventures, and protagonists from apocalyptic settings—the world had become exceedingly dangerous.
However, Min Hyemi was…
“Are you curious about the kind of world I came from?!”
“M-Ms. Min Hyemi?”
“An explicit 19+ dark reverse harem with obsessive and tragic elements!”
“……”
“T-This story has no relation to the author’s personal beliefs!”
“I’m sorry.”
That’s right.
She was a returnee from an explicit 19+ world.
***
“I’ll kill anyone who dares to love me.”
Min Hyemi, who has progressed beyond distrust of love to outright hatred of humanity.
“I thought you’d hate me if I fell in love with you, so before meeting you, I made sure to mess up my own mind.”
She must evade a deranged terrorist group member who is obsessed with her.
“It’s alright. Saving humanity is my mission.”
And navigate her daily life alongside an awakened individual who loves humanity excessively.
Will Min Hyemi be able to stick to her original goal of never loving anyone?
associated_names: I am a returnee from a 19+ world

99027.synopsis:
Don’t think I’ll love you forever!
A story about a boy who is fed up with his childhood friend girlfriend cheating on him, so he quickly breaks up with her and enjoys college life with his best college friend.
associated_names: 超絶美人な幼馴染の彼女が浮気しててもう完全に愛想が尽きたからさっさと別れて大学のめっちゃ仲良い男友達とウェーイしながら大学生活を謳歌していく話

100819.synopsis: Even without limbs, there is no inconvenience in enjoying virtual reality games. But people around me look at me sadly.

101331.synopsis:
Tan Zhui originally sealed his mountain , spending his days lazily eating, drinking, and sleeping, living a retired life like an immortal.
Unbeknownst to him, someone left a child at the mountain, perhaps seeing the White Deer Immortal Lord living too comfortably.
Tan Zhui named the child Sui Chunsheng and raised him as his closed-door disciple.
He originally thought of continuing the mountain gate and having each other for company, but as the child grew up, he discovered that the child was exceptionally skilled at cooking! (Legitimate cooking)
Tan Zhui grew increasingly fond of his disciple, but unknowingly, his feelings began to change.
One day, Tan Zhui was drugged with an aphrodisiac and was thoroughly taken advantage of by his beloved disciple.
With tears in his eyes and a hazy mind, he bit his tongue to stay awake, “No… no…”
Sui Chunsheng: “Master, no to what?”
“No to such absurdity…”
“Master, you and I, we should be absurd.”
At that moment, the beloved disciple turned into a wicked one.
When the truth came to light, heavenly soldiers surrounded the place.
Tan Zhui stabbed his wicked disciple through the heart with his sword, expelling him from the mountain, watching his former beloved disciple fall to his death.
Years later, unexpectedly, the wicked disciple one day descended upon the nine heavens with his army.
“Hand over the White Deer Immortal Lord, and I will immediately withdraw my troops.”
And so, the dignified White Deer Immortal Lord was taken back to the military camp by the demon lord.
He thought the demon lord would seek revenge for the sword strike, thoroughly ravaging the former god.
But unexpectedly, the demon lord turned around and married the god to warm his bed, just changing the location of the ravaging and torment…

102867.synopsis:
In his previous life, Yuto was reincarnated as Sol in the world of his favorite game, and in order to make his favorite character Celes and her friends happy, he used his knowledge of the original story from his previous life to inject himself with a noxious gas and died, or so he thought.
But somehow he is alive, and before he wakes up, a mysterious voice tells him to make a happy ending.
He begins his journey, thinking that he is talking about a backstage boss he has yet to defeat, but there is something strange about his companions and Celes.
Moreover, the world is not what he thought it would be, as if a “forcing force” has been triggered. ……?
associated_names: 仲間の幸せのため嫌われ役になって死んだはずなのに、真実を知った前世の推しキャラが禁術で俺を蘇生していました

106195.synopsis:
“It’s because of you, Mother.”
Elicity loved her daughter dearly.
She worked tirelessly to make sure her beloved child would become the queen of the great nation of Salita—and she succeeded.
Or at least, she thought she had.
Until her daughter, stricken with illness, resented her until her dying breath.
Shocked by the loss of her beloved child, Elicity collapsed.
And when she awoke… her daughter was there, young once more.
*
After returning to the past, Elicity vowed that this time, she would let her daughter live as she truly wished.
“I want you and Dad to get along!”
As it turned out, her daughter’s deepest wish was to have a happy family. Before her regression, Elicity had been estranged from her husband, Alex. So, for the sake of their daughter, she resolved to reach out to him.
Fortunately, Alex did not push her away. In fact, his response was surprisingly… enthusiastic.
“Come here. The night is short.”
“D-Dear, wait…!”
In the end, he even confessed his love.
“Elicity, I love you.”
But the real problem was—she was broken.
‘…He never loved me. Those words are nothing more than lust.’
And yet, her heart pounded. And Elicity was afraid.
Afraid that she might fall in love again with a husband who had never truly loved her.

107475.synopsis:
As a sleep-deprived and struggling writer, I knew that writing could cause hair loss—but I never expected it could also lead to transmigration.
Wearing my cotton slippers and a simple two-piece outfit, I opened my eyes to find myself standing in a vast, lush forest.
In this prehistoric jungle, where even the mosquitoes were bigger than my face, I—utterly weak and defenseless—began my miserable journey of eating grass, eating grass, and eating more grass…
Then, as the last remaining human on Earth, I was captured.
Me: … The hell do you mean, the last human?! A critically endangered species?! So I’m basically a prehistoric relic now?!
Meanwhile, my newly appointed, cold and absurdly powerful human caretaker (who also doubles as my personal poop scooper) squatted down with a dog food bowl in hand, expressionless like a complete idiot:
“Come. Eat your food.”
Me: … Who the hell do you think you’re looking down on?! I— I’ll flip your damn bowl!

108499.synopsis:
The fleet admiral who brought about humanity’s defeat returns to life—and is reborn as the most powerful noble daughter! “Defeat the aliens? Return to Earth? I’ll accomplish it all!”
Lillian, a space fleet admiral who was defeated in a war against aliens, finds herself back in time as an eighteen-year-old girl. She lost last time due to her own mistakes. This time, she’ll win and change that horrific future!
But immediately facing her is a space battleship adrift during military academy exercises and an alien attack (First Contact). Using her tactical eye and knowledge of the future, Lillian rallies inexperienced students and confronts an alien fleet with just a single battleship. Her miraculous achievements will lead to a future where humanity survives.
associated_names: Akuyaku reijō, uchū o kakeru futatabime no jinseide wa uchū kantai o hikiite hoshikansensō o shōri ni michibikimasu
The Villainess Runs Through Space: In My Second Life, I’ll Lead Space Fleet to Victory in Interstellar War (Light Novel)
悪役令嬢, 宇宙を駆ける 二度目の人生では宇宙艦隊を率いて星間戦争を勝利に導きます

111827.synopsis:
Lian Ai was just a beds*ave. Delicate, obedient, and well-trained in all the arts of seduction. One day, he was handed over as a gift from the Prime Minister to the feared old General Bu, a man rumored to be ruthless in both war and pleasure. But on the very night of his arrival, the General was assassinated.
Bu Nian inherited more than just his father’s armor and influence. He also inherited a house full of playthings… and Lian Ai was the most dangerous of them all. Not because he wielded a blade, but because he knew how to make a man hesitate before using one.
*A general who trusts no one × A beds*ave who longs for freedom.

112083.synopsis:
“Chatty Sunshine Heroine × Powerful Mute Tycoon, Arranged Marriage to Love + Sweet Romance + Lighthearted Daily Life”
Sang Lu has awakened.
In the original storyline, she was the villainous sister-in-law of a wealthy family—disdaining her mute husband, colluding with greedy relatives to embezzle the family fortune, and committing every evil deed imaginable.
Her husband ignored her. Her brothers-in-law slapped her. Her ending was tragic.
“Wait… so I’m the big idiot here?”
Absolutely not.
Her dreams are simple: safety and riches!
As long as she avoids becoming everyone’s least favorite person, her dreams are within reach~
She stays up all night drafting a Survival Guide:
★ Bring her arranged-marriage husband some calming herbal tea—his insomnia might slow down her money-counting speed.
★ Catch the brother-in-law’s swinging hand mid-slap: “Try that again and I’ll knock your head into orbit!”
★ Attend a high-society gala arm-in-arm with her husband: “My husband’s voice? Oh, it lives on my lips~”
Six months later—
The arrogant second brother races over on his motorcycle: “Big Sis, scold me again, please!”
The brooding third brother glares into the camera: “Anyone who messes with my sister-in-law answers to me first.”
The family patriarch, warm and blunt, shoves a stack of documents into her hands.
「Luxury resort land ×1」「Private islands ×2」「Pigeon-blood ruby jewelry ×10 sets」
Sang Lu: ???
One night—
The silent man pins her beneath him, his voice—deep and magnetic—finally breaking free, whispering words that burn her ears.
“Again.”
P.S. The male lead has selective mutism, not actual muteness—and yes, he will recover.

114387.synopsis:
Xie Yi’an transmigrated into a high-risk world.
Right from the start, he triggered a special event and was forced to bind a hidden identity card with an extremely high mortality rate.
The beginner’s gift pack he received was the universally acknowledged tr*sh ability 【Performance Rules】.
At the same time, he discovered a secret:
Every player entering the dungeon was bound to an invisible live stream, where mysterious viewers were mockingly watching the players’ life-and-death struggles.
He was the only player who knew about the live stream and could see the viewers’ comments.
Xie Yi’an: …
This looks like a surefire way to die.
A normal person would already be considering restarting.
Not only was Xie Yi’an not afraid, but he even came up with a bold idea.
The viewers were familiar with the dungeon’s plot development, and every comment could reveal crucial clues.
Only he could see the comments, only he could know the information that would affect the “future.”
With such an information advantage, why not play the prophet and trick some NPCs?
Xie Yi’an decisively started acting.
–
From the day the anomalies descended, humanity has never gained the upper hand in the war against them.
The dungeons carrying the anomalies appeared without any pattern.
Every time a dungeon appeared, it claimed countless lives, and decades of darkness left people in despair.
Until the 【Prophet】 appeared.
Xie Yi’an repeatedly turned the tide for humanity.
He became the spiritual pillar for countless players, a private deity for humanity.
–
Players: I heard the Prophet can even control anomalies (worship.jpg).

114899.synopsis:
Transmigrated into a game, became a supporting female character, and even activated the hidden nightmare difficulty?

She thought she could rely on hundreds of playthroughs to discreetly develop and eventually take control, but she immediately encountered a problem: the final boss, the Dragon King, had actually recovered her memories and was blocking the novice village!
Good news:
The Dragon King seems unaware that Reina is the one who “killed” her…

115155.synopsis:
Chu Qingwan came from a prestigious family, dazzlingly beautiful and radiant beyond compare. She grew up alongside a childhood sweetheart, and both families had long agreed to form a marriage alliance.
But before the Xie family could propose, news arrived from the palace—
The Empress Dowager intended to select consorts for His Majesty, and all eligible unmarried noble daughters were to enter the selection process.
Suddenly, Chu Qingwan faced two paths:
— Proceed with the engagement to the Xie family
— Or enter the palace for the selection
That very day, her father summoned her to the study. She remained inside all day.
On the day she entered the palace by imperial decree, she vaguely saw a familiar figure standing at a distance.
Chu Qingwan calmly looked away.
She thought to herself—perhaps she truly was a woman enamored with status and power.
That day in the study, her father had said only one thing:
“The position of Empress is vacant.”
And that alone was enough for her to make her choice.
When Xu Yanheng first met Chu Qingwan, he knew she was clever.
But he had always dismissed it—after all, she was just another palace consort, not worth his attention.
Until he found out about the engagement that almost was.
Suddenly, he began to wonder—
When Chu Qingwan entered the palace by imperial decree, how much of it was truly her own will, and how much was because one cannot defy a royal order?
Love may not be irrelevant, but for someone as calculating as her, she would only offer her affections if there were guaranteed returns.
Note: Palace intrigue genre. The male lead is not a virg*n.
[This novel includes the previously requested elements: palace intrigue + childhood sweetheart. But fair warning—I’m personally partial to writing female leads with clear ambitions.]

117203.synopsis:
Due to a friend’s betrayal, Yang Yohan ends up in the worst dungeon of all, the Abyss. In this monster-infested dungeon, Yohan encounters Lee Hyunmook, once considered the strongest Awakened in Korea, who had gone missing in the Abyss years ago.
“Mr. Lee Hyunmook, please don’t kill me, okay? I’m human…”
“Human…”
“Yes, I’m human… and so are you, Mr. Lee Hyunmook.”
However, Lee Hyunmuk has been half-driven mad by the influence of the Abyss. Yohan struggles to survive alongside him, tending to wounds and foraging for food, during the rare moments when Hyunmook regains his sanity.
“Every few decades, a certain phenomenon occurs here. And I call it a ‘Flood.’”
“A Flood?”
“The closer the Flood gets, the worse the contamination and madness become… just like how I was moments ago.”
But when an unexpected Flood strikes, Hyunmook loses his mind completely…
“You’re a sheep, so why don’t you cry?”
“I-I’m not a sheep, I’m Yang Yohan…”
“My little sheep.”
A brutal environment, a festering wound on one leg, terrifying monsters howling as they attack, and now the erratic behavior of a deranged Hyunmook…
Thus begins Yohan’s tear-filled escape from another world!
associated_names: Follow the Lamb Into the Abyss
Follow the Sheep in the Abyss

118739.synopsis:
Plot
“It’s kind of embarrassing when you make that face… after keeping someone up all night.”
Tae Seung-jo’s arrogant eyes scanned Hae-joo’s face.
He was the managing director of Taehwa Group.
Her boss.
Her first love.
And the man she had secretly loved for years.
“From now on, I’ll be your bed partner, Seon-joo.”
Seon-joo had said he liked her—and she had liked his body just as much.
That night, everything felt so good, so real.
Now, Seung-jo couldn’t stop thinking about her. The look in her eyes still lingered in his mind.
Hae-joo, with her eyes tightly shut, took a deep breath.
She could still feel his strong fingers brushing her lips, remember the heat in his deep black eyes—a gaze full of desire, wild yet clear.
How had things turned out like this… with him?
Held in Seung-jo’s arms, Hae-joo tried her best to hide the sound of her pounding heart.

122835.synopsis:
Chen Yang had six female disciples.
At first, these six girls didn’t have much talent or potential.
But with his help, each of them underwent a complete transformation, eventually becoming peerless prodigies that were one in a million!
In the end, all six of them even rose to become mighty Emperors, shaking the world across all realms!
What Chen Yang didn’t expect was that those six ungrateful snakes would turn on him together and send him to his death!
Before dying, Chen Yang personally killed the six backstabbing traitors and cleaned house!
But he too collapsed from exhaustion and died.
Fortunately, when he opened his eyes again, Chen Yang had been reborn—back three thousand years in the past.
This time, staring at the six ungrateful snakes kneeling in front of him, full of regret and begging to be taken in as disciples once more…
Chen Yang said coldly: “Hell no, I’m not taking you back!”
……
After Chen Yang was reborn, his six female disciples were also reborn!
In their previous lives, they had become Emperors under Chen Yang’s all-out guidance.
In this life, they were convinced they could achieve the same heights without relying on Chen Yang.
But gradually, they realized—without Chen Yang’s help, they were just ordinary people.
If they wanted to become Emperors on their own? That was as hard as reaching the heavens!
Slowly, regret began to set in…
But when they finally decided to beg Chen Yang to take them back as disciples…
They discovered that no matter how hard they pleaded this time, the master who had once doted on them…
Was completely, ruthlessly unmoved.

123091.synopsis:
Elaine was an orphan but was fortunately adopted into the Waylon ducal family.
She was happy. She had her brother Rahul who always took her side and a lover who cherished her.
“Haah! Ahh!”
“Ugh. My lady. Please allow me to put it in now.”
Elaine’s emerald eyes, blurry with tears, trembled for a moment.
Creeak.
“Ra, Rahul. Bro… ther.”
“Elaine. You should have been quiet. Even in a cabin in a rarely visited forest, someone might hear if you make noise.”
Afterward, strange rumors began to spread throughout the Waylon ducal mansion.
Pierce Ogden, the young lord, entered the reception room of the Waylon ducal family to meet his fiancée.
“Ah!”
When the servant opened the door, a sensual female moan burst out, causing Pierce to freeze.
“Elaine, ugh. You need to lift your hips properly.”

The wet sound of flesh slapping against flesh and the pungent smell suddenly stimulated his senses.
He showed an expression of disbelief at the obscene scene that was almost sordid.

Rahul, his blond hair soaked with sweat, noticed the presence and tilted his head.
His well-defined muscles glistened in the light, still expanded from the passionate lovemaking moments ago.

“Welcome to the Waylon ducal family, Lord Pierce Ogden.”

131539.synopsis:
The two people who left Area 17 to gather information about the changed world encounter a suspicious group.
“The world is more complicated than I thought.”
“The solution is simple.”
“What is it?”
“Kill them all.”
* * *
The tropical rainforest was humid and dark. With every step, sticky mud clung to the feet, leaving deep footprints behind. The chirping of birds and the buzzing of insects filled the air. The occasional rays of sunlight pierced through the thick canopy. The foul stench of a decaying chunk of meat permeated the air.
“I’m ready. Tell me.”
“There’s something strange inside you.”
“…?”
Something strange inside me? Her eyes wavered in confusion at the incomprehensible words.
“Do I have cancer?”
“No.”
“Is there a parasite growing inside me?”
“Something like that.”
“…Am I turning into a zombie?”
“That’s not it.”
“Then what is it?”
“Something that’s not even human is growing in your belly.”
“My, belly…?”
Boyeon lowered her head and stared at her flat stomach. Growing in her belly? Something that’s not even human? This man, could it be…
“Am I… pregnant?”
“I can hear a heartbeat. Something has taken over your womb.”
“…What are you talking about! It’s our baby!”

133075.synopsis:
Raham is a s*ave dragged before the lord for the crime of killing his former master.
“Carlie is perfect for taming disobedient beasts.”
The lord sends him to his sister, Carlie.
Carlie, whom he met while tensely calculating escape angles, was a somewhat suspicious but naive and relaxed beauty.
Moreover, unlike before, there was little work and abundant food.
Was there really a need to escape?
Raham finds himself torn between a well-fed, peaceful environment and running away.
To such a man, Carlie proposes a highly suspicious deal……
“Since you’re exactly my type anyway, play with me a little.”
“……What kind of play do you mean?”
“I’d like you to torment me as much as I want.”
“What is your reason for ordering me to do such a thing?”
“I like that kind of thing. More precisely, being treated badly.”
Though it’s absurd for a master to ask to be tormented, as a s*ave he cannot refuse.
Raham reluctantly agrees, but as days pass, he gradually falls deeper under the spell of her beautiful form.
Will he truly be able to escape from his master Carlie and shed his s*ave status?

137171.synopsis:
Since childhood, she had yielded everything and sacrificed for her younger sister with a weak body.
She had never hated it.
Because Fiona was the older sister; because Marianne was a younger sister she wanted to give everything to.
“I’m so happy. I’m really going to marry Lennox? Really?”
Even if he was a man Fiona loved. And a man who loved her and even sent a marriage proposal.
Marianne died.
Fiona was sad, and she loathed herself for not being able to completely abandon her feelings for Lennox.
She felt sorry to the dead Marianne, as if she had betrayed her. She felt sorry to Lennox too, for making him lose his wife after only a few months of marriage due to her own stubbornness.
And Lennox came to find Fiona.
Really, with an absurd proposal.

137683.synopsis:
After getting into an accident while visiting a friend to critique their bizarre BL captivity novel, Juwon wakes up inside that very story—just two hours before his character’s death. That’s when he meets Hajin, someone who never existed in the original plot.
“If I destroy your last shred of hope, the three of us could live happily ever after.”
But faced with Hajin, who seems just as unhinged as Hahyun, the original male lead, Juwon makes a desperate gamble: he pretends to have amnesia.
“Who are you? Do you know me?”
“…What the hell is wrong with you? Have you lost your mind?”
As the twisted story suddenly becomes his reality, Juwon struggles to manage the Seo brothers’ obsessive behavior and find an escape route through all the chaos, but…
“The outside world is too dangerous for you, hyung.”
So-called “protective captivity.”
There’s something deeply twisted tangled up in this imprisonment.

162259.synopsis:
Modern-day Japan where dungeons exist. An utterly ordinary useless human, Asagiri Nayuta quit his job and became unemployed. Then he got addicted to a gacha game and burned through all his savings, couldn’t pay the rent, and was pressured by the landlord to move out. Well then, guess I’ve got no choice but to go to this dungeon thing and make some money! With that idiotic line of thinking, Nayuta dove eagerly into a dungeon and then died.
But through the piling up of every possible coincidence, Nayuta revives by possessing the corpse (zombie) of a gloomy introverted girl who had gone in with him. However, that girl was what you’d call a bottom-tier loser woman, like someone had crammed in every possible trait that would make her unpopular with men. Even so, Nayuta doesn’t give up. Awaken the special abilities hidden within the girl’s body, and rise to become the strongest, invincible beautiful girl!
This is the story of me, who ended up TS-ing into a bottom-tier loser zombie girl, aiming to become the strongest and greatest beautiful girl!

169427.synopsis:
The Most Vulnerable Side of You, the “Unattainable Flower”
​Amano Iori’s childhood friend, Yukimura Mizuki, is the school’s “unattainable flower”—the kind of girl everyone envies from afar. But ever since the day Iori was confessed to by another girl, Mizuki has suddenly started closing the distance between them. And now… before he even realized it, why are you sleeping right next to me looking like that?
associated_names: 顔の良すぎる幼馴染と、気づいたら朝チュンしてた件

192467.synopsis:
Ye Mian is the youngest legitimate son of his family. As the saying goes, birds of a feather flock together; his circle of close friends consists entirely of the youngest or second sons of the capital’s most prestigious noble houses. During their days studying at the Imperial Academy, this gang of “I’m second only to Heaven” privileged second-generation scions lived life with such fervor that they seemed ready to poke a hole through the sky.
One day they’d be making mischief in the classroom, ripping tiles off the roof; the next, they’d be calling on their friends to gallop on horseback through the outskirts of the capital, trampling the spring breeze under their golden saddles.
The proctors of the Imperial Academy were driven to splitting headaches, trying to coax them: “Study peacefully! Once you finish your time at the Imperial Academy, you will enter officialdom through your family’s status, and from then on, you will be free of constraints. The imperial court has a different kind of joy waiting for you—you’ll be able to live as you please!”
Hearing this, these sons of officials became even more invigorated. Since childhood, they had envied their fathers and brothers for not having to sit in classrooms memorizing books—simply checking in at the government office in the morning and attending banquets at taverns in the evening. How carefree and unrestrained!
While kneeling in punishment along the hallway of the dormitory, the group babbled and argued, imagining their future careers as officials to be something akin to a blissful celestial paradise.
The proctors, listening nearby, exchanged cold smiles: A bunch of little brats! Once you step out of these gates and enter the tiger-and-wolf den that is the imperial court, the stern rules of officialdom and the cynical ways of the world will teach you how to be human all over again!
